description: This PHP source file defines the JsChart class, which extends SugarChart, and implements methods for processing, rendering, and generating JSON data for various types of charts (pie, bar, line, gauge, funnel) based on XML configuration files within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: JsChart
classes.description: A class representing a JavaScript chart object, capable of rendering various chart types (pie, bar, line, gauge, funnel) using configuration XML files and generating corresponding JSON data for visualization, extended from the SugarChart base class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the JsChart object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given chart type is supported by the class.

methods.name: tab
methods.description: Returns a string with specified indentation and the input string, used for formatting generated code.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to process XML file, generate JSON for chart, and assign variables to the templating system for rendering a chart.

methods.name: getDashletScript
methods.description: Generates and assigns variables for dashlet chart rendering, possibly for embedded dashboard components.

methods.name: chartArray
methods.description: Creates an array of chart configurations from an input array of chart data.

methods.name: getChartConfigParams
methods.description: Extracts chart configuration parameters based on chart type from XML string.

methods.name: getChartDimensions
methods.description: Calculates chart dimensions based on XML data and chart type.

methods.name: checkData
methods.description: Checks whether the XML data contains group data used for chart rendering.

methods.name: getNumNodes
methods.description: Counts the number of data group nodes in the XML.

methods.name: buildProperties
methods.description: Builds a string representing chart properties from XML data.

methods.name: buildLabelsBarChartStacked
methods.description: Builds label data for stacked bar charts from XML.

methods.name: buildLabelsBarChart
methods.description: Builds label data for bar charts, handling stacked and normal cases.

methods.name: buildDataBarChartStacked
methods.description: Builds data series for stacked bar charts.

methods.name: buildDataBarChartGrouped
methods.description: Builds data series for grouped bar charts.

methods.name: buildDataBarChart
methods.description: Builds data series for standard bar charts.

methods.name: buildDataPieChart
methods.description: Builds data series for pie charts.

methods.name: buildLabelsPieChart
methods.description: Builds label data for pie charts.

methods.name: buildDataGaugeChart
methods.description: Builds data for gauge charts.

methods.name: buildLabelsGaugeChart
methods.description: Builds labels for gauge charts.

methods.name: buildJson
methods.description: Generates the complete JSON configuration for a chart based on XML and chart type.

methods.name: saveJsonFile
methods.description: Writes JSON chart data to a file.

methods.name: get_image_cache_file_name
methods.description: Returns a filename for cached chart images.

methods.name: getXMLChartProperties
methods.description: Extracts chart properties from XML string.

methods.name: processSpecialChars
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities and escapes quotes for XML content.

methods.name: processXML
methods.description: Reads and processes XML chart configuration files, encoding them appropriately.
